PF_PLIST = "/Library/LaunchDaemons/%s.plist" % PF_LABEL
HF_MODEL_RE = re.compile(r"models--[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+")
DEFAULT_HF_MODEL = "models--sentence-transformers--all-MiniLM-L6-v2"

WRAPPERS = (  # wrapper name -> module that provides main(argv)
    ("zurvan-broker", "broker"),
    ("zurvan-candidate-run", "candidate_run"),
    ("zurvan-author", "author"),
)
BROKER_WRAPPER = BROKER_BIN + "/zurvan-broker"
CANDIDATE_WRAPPER = BROKER_BIN + "/zurvan-candidate-run"
EXPORT_PATHS = ("scripts/eval_seal", "scripts/boundary/d1.py")
USER_RE = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}")
SHA_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}")
RESERVED_USERS = frozenset(["root", "ALL", EVAL_USER, CANDIDATE_USER])
FORBIDDEN_STAGE_PREFIXES = ("/etc", "/private/etc", "/Library", "/System", "/usr", "/bin", "/sbin",
                            "/Applications", "/var/at", "/private/var/at", "/private/var/db")


class OperatorRefusal(Exception):
    """A refusal with a human-readable reason (operator scripts only; never crosses the broker boundary)."""


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ validation

def validate_sha(sha):
    if not isinstance(sha, str) or SHA_RE.fullmatch(sha) is None:
        raise OperatorRefusal("the sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters")
    return sha


def validate_user(name):
    if not isinstance(name, str) or USER_RE.fullmatch(name) is None or name in RESERVED_USERS:
        raise OperatorRefusal("invalid or reserved development user name")
    return name


def check_stage(stage):
    real = os.path.realpath(str(stage))
    if real == "/":
        raise OperatorRefusal("the render directory must not be /")
    for pre in FORBIDDEN_STAGE_PREFIXES:
        if real == pre or real.startswith(pre + "/"):
            raise OperatorRefusal("the render directory must not be inside %s" % pre)
    return Path(os.path.abspath(str(stage)))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ plan

class _Raw(str):
    """A command token that is emitted unquoted (shell variables)."""


class Plan:
    def __init__(self, kind, stage):
        self.kind = kind
        self.stage = Path(stage)
        self.lines = []

    def comment(self, text):
        for part in str(text).splitlines() or [""]:
            self.lines.append(("# " + part).rstrip())

    def cmd(self, *argv):
        self.lines.append(" ".join(a if isinstance(a, _Raw) else shlex.quote(str(a)) for a in argv))

    def raw(self, line):
        if "\n" in line:
            raise OperatorRefusal("internal: command line contains a newline")
        self.lines.append(line)

    def staged_path(self, final):
        return self.stage / str(final).lstrip("/")

    def stage_bytes(self, final, data):
        dest = self.staged_path(final)
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        dest.write_bytes(data)
        os.chmod(str(dest), 0o600)
        return dest

    def stage_copy(self, final, src):
        """Stream src into the stage; return the sha256 of the staged bytes."""
        dest = self.staged_path(final)
        dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        h = hashlib.sha256()
        with open(str(src), "rb") as fin, open(str(dest), "wb") as fout:
            while True:
                chunk = fin.read(1 << 20)
                if not chunk:
                    break
                h.update(chunk)
                fout.write(chunk)
        os.chmod(str(dest), 0o600)
        return h.hexdigest()

    def install_dir(self, path, owner, group, mode):
        self.cmd("/usr/bin/install", "-d", "-o", owner, "-g", group, "-m", mode, path)

    def install_file(self, final, data, owner, group, mode):
        staged = self.stage_bytes(final, data)
        self.install_staged(final, staged, owner, group, mode)

    def install_staged(self, final, staged, owner, group, mode):
        self.cmd("/usr/bin/install", "-o", owner, "-g", group, "-m", mode, staged, final)

    def write(self):
        self.stage.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        head = [
            "# zurvan-eval operator plan: %s" % self.kind,
            "# Generated by scripts/eval_seal/render.py. With --render this is a PLAN only: nothing was changed.",
            "# In real mode this exact file is executed by /bin/bash -euo pipefail as root.",
            "# Files it installs are staged below this directory, mirroring absolute paths.",
        ]
        text = "\n".join(head + self.lines) + "\n"
        out = self.stage / "commands.txt"
        out.write_text(text)
        os.chmod(str(out), 0o600)


def _fail_line(msg):
    return "echo %s >&2; exit 1" % shlex.quote("refusing: " + msg)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ git (read only, defensive)

def _git(repo, git_user, args):
    argv = ["/usr/bin/git", "--no-optional-locks", "-c", "safe.directory=%s" % repo, "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false",
            "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null", "-c", "core.attributesFile=/dev/null", "-C", str(repo)] + list(args)
    if os.geteuid() == 0 and git_user:
        # root never executes anything named by the dev-writable repo config: git runs as the dev user
        argv = ["/usr/bin/sudo", "-n", "-u", git_user, "-H"] + argv
    env = {"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null", "GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM": "1",
           "GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT": "0", "LANG": "C"}
    p = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, env=env)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr


def check_commit(repo, sha, git_user):
    validate_sha(sha)
    rc, _o, _e = _git(repo, git_user, ["cat-file", "-e", sha + "^{commit}"])
    if rc != 0:
        raise OperatorRefusal("%s is not a commit in %s" % (sha, repo))
    rc, _o, _e = _git(repo, git_user, ["merge-base", "--is-ancestor", sha, "HEAD"])
    if rc == 1:
        raise OperatorRefusal("%s is not contained in HEAD of %s" % (sha, repo))
    if rc != 0:
        raise OperatorRefusal("could not compare %s with HEAD" % sha)


def assert_clean_tree(repo, sha, git_user):
    """The scripts root is about to run live in the working tree: they must be the reviewed bytes."""
    validate_sha(sha)
    rc, _o, _e = _git(repo, git_user, ["diff", "--no-ext-diff", "--no-textconv", "--quiet", sha, "--"] + list(EXPORT_PATHS))
    if rc == 1:
        raise OperatorRefusal("the working tree differs from %s under scripts/eval_seal" % sha)
    if rc != 0:
        raise OperatorRefusal("could not diff the working tree against %s" % sha)
    rc, out, _e = _git(repo, git_user, ["status", "--porcelain", "--untracked-files=all", "--"] + list(EXPORT_PATHS))
    if rc != 0:
        raise OperatorRefusal("could not read the working tree status")
    if any(ln.startswith(b"??") for ln in out.splitlines()):
        raise OperatorRefusal("untracked files under scripts/eval_seal")


def _blob_oid(data):
    return hashlib.sha1(b"blob %d\x00" % len(data) + data).hexdigest()


def export_sources(repo, sha, git_user):
    """git archive <sha> scripts/eval_seal scripts/boundary/d1.py, verified; returns {relpath: bytes}."""
    validate_sha(sha)
    rc, out, _e = _git(repo, git_user, ["ls-tree", "-r", "-z", "--full-tree", sha, "--"] + list(EXPORT_PATHS))
    if rc != 0 or not out:
        raise OperatorRefusal("the sources are missing at %s" % sha)
    want = {}
    for entry in out.split(b"\x00"):
        if not entry:
            continue
        meta, _tab, path = entry.partition(b"\t")
        mode, typ, oid = meta.decode("ascii").split(" ")
        name = path.decode("utf-8")
        if mode == "120000":
            raise OperatorRefusal("a symlink exists in the reviewed tree: %s" % name)
        if typ != "blob" or mode not in ("100644", "100755"):
            raise OperatorRefusal("non-regular entry in the reviewed tree: %s" % name)
        want[name] = oid
    rc, tar_bytes, _e = _git(repo, git_user, ["archive", "--format=tar", sha, "--"] + list(EXPORT_PATHS))
    if rc != 0:
        raise OperatorRefusal("git archive failed for %s" % sha)
    got = {}
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(tar_bytes), mode="r:") as tf:
        for m in tf.getmembers():
            name = m.name
            if m.isdir():
                continue
            if m.issym() or m.islnk():
                raise OperatorRefusal("the archive contains a symlink or hardlink: %s" % name)
            if not m.isfile():
                raise OperatorRefusal("the archive contains a special file: %s" % name)
            parts = name.split("/")
            if name.startswith("/") or ".." in parts or not name.startswith(("scripts/eval_seal/", "scripts/boundary/")):
                raise OperatorRefusal("the archive contains an unexpected path: %s" % name)
            got[name] = tf.extractfile(m).read()
    if set(got) != set(want):
        raise OperatorRefusal("the archive and the git tree disagree about which files exist")
    for name, data in got.items():
        if _blob_oid(data) != want[name]:
            raise OperatorRefusal("exported bytes differ from the git object for %s" % name)
    return got


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ wrappers, sudoers

def wrapper_text(module):
    return (
        "#!%s -I\n"
        "import sys\n"
        'sys.path.insert(0, "%s")\n'
        "from scripts.eval_seal.%s import main\n"
        "sys.exit(main(sys.argv[1:]))\n"
    ) % (CLT_PYTHON, BROKER_LIB, module)


def _sha256(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def _sudoers_lines():
    defaults = [
        "Defaults>%s env_reset, !setenv, !env_keep, !env_check" % EVAL_USER,
        "Defaults>%s env_reset, !setenv, !env_keep, !env_check" % CANDIDATE_USER,
    ]
    return defaults


_RULE_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?P<who>[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]{0,63}) ALL=\((?P<runas>[a-z]+)\) NOPASSWD: sha256:(?P<dig>[0-9a-f]{64}) (?P<path>/\S+)")
_INCLUDE_RE = re.compile(r"#\s*(include|includedir)\b")


def validate_sudoers(text, wrappers):
    """Structural allowlist. `wrappers` maps absolute installed path -> bytes. Returns a list of problems."""
    problems = []
    if "\\" in text:
        problems.append("backslash: line continuation is not allowed anywhere in the file")
    defaults_seen = []
    rules = []
    for ln in text.split("\n"):
        if ln == "":
            continue
        if _INCLUDE_RE.match(ln):
            problems.append("include directive not allowed: %r" % ln[:60])
            continue
        if ln.startswith("#"):
            continue
        if ln in _sudoers_lines():
            defaults_seen.append(ln)
            continue
        m = _RULE_RE.fullmatch(ln)
        if m is None:
            problems.append("unexpected rule line: %r" % ln[:80])
            continue
        rules.append(m)
    if sorted(defaults_seen) != sorted(_sudoers_lines()):
        problems.append("missing or duplicated Defaults line: the rule set must reset and empty the environment")
    if len(rules) != 2:
        problems.append("rule count: expected exactly 2 rules, found %d" % len(rules))
        return problems
    want = (
        (EVAL_USER, BROKER_WRAPPER, True),
        (CANDIDATE_USER, CANDIDATE_WRAPPER, False),
    )
    for m, (runas, path, dev_rule) in zip(rules, want):
        who = m.group("who")
        if dev_rule and who in RESERVED_USERS:
            problems.append("rule: invalid invoking user %r" % who)
        if not dev_rule and who != EVAL_USER:
            problems.append("rule: the second rule must be invoked by %s" % EVAL_USER)
        if m.group("runas") != runas:
            problems.append("rule: run-as must be exactly (%s), found (%s)" % (runas, m.group("runas")))
        if m.group("path") != path:
            problems.append("rule: path must be exactly %s" % path)
            continue
        if path not in wrappers:
            problems.append("rule: no wrapper bytes supplied for %s" % path)
        elif m.group("dig") != _sha256(wrappers[path]):
            problems.append("digest mismatch for %s" % path)
    return problems


def render_sudoers(dev_user, wrappers):
    validate_user(dev_user)
    for need in (BROKER_WRAPPER, CANDIDATE_WRAPPER):
        if need not in wrappers:
            raise OperatorRefusal("internal: missing wrapper %s" % need)
    tmpl = Template((TEMPLATES / "sudoers.tmpl").read_text())
    text = tmpl.substitute(
        DEV_USER=dev_user, EVAL_USER=EVAL_USER, CANDIDATE_USER=CANDIDATE_USER,
        BROKER_PATH=BROKER_WRAPPER, BROKER_DIGEST=_sha256(wrappers[BROKER_WRAPPER]),
        CANDIDATE_RUN_PATH=CANDIDATE_WRAPPER, CANDIDATE_RUN_DIGEST=_sha256(wrappers[CANDIDATE_WRAPPER]))
    problems = validate_sudoers(text, wrappers)
    if problems:
        raise OperatorRefusal("rendered sudoers failed its own validation: %s" % "; ".join(problems))
    return text


def _render_template(name, **kw):
    return Template((TEMPLATES / name).read_text()).substitute(**kw)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ plans

def _acl(perms):
    return "user:%s allow %s" % (EVAL_USER, perms)


def _acl_targets(dev_home, repo):
    """(search-only chain, full-read targets). Targets are the scan set of spec s5.6."""
    full = [
        dev_home + "/.claude/projects/*Zurvan*",
        repo + "/data/traces",
        repo + "/wiki/traces",
        repo + "/logs",
        dev_home + "/.zurvan/reports",
    ]
    search = []

    def add_chain(path):
        # every ancestor from dev_home down to the parent of path
        base = dev_home.rstrip("/")
        if not (path == base or path.startswith(base + "/")):
            return
        cur = base
        rel = path[len(base):].strip("/")
        chain = [cur]
        for part in [p for p in rel.split("/") if p][:-1]:
            if "*" in part:
                break
            cur = cur + "/" + part
            chain.append(cur)
        for c in chain:
            if c not in search:
                search.append(c)

    for t in full:
        add_chain(t)
    # the repo and its data/wiki parents sit under dev_home normally; if not, they still need search
    for extra in (repo, repo + "/data", repo + "/wiki"):
        if extra not in search:
            search.append(extra)
    # keep ~/.zurvan reachable (parent of reports)
    return search, full


def _quote_target(path):
    """Quote a path but keep every '*' live for the shell (the scan glob)."""
    if "*" not in path:
        return path
    return _Raw("*".join(shlex.quote(seg) if seg else "" for seg in path.split("*")))


def plan_setup(plan, dev_home, repo):
    search, full = _acl_targets(dev_home, repo)
    plan.comment("setup: two non-admin identities, one shared corpus group, sealed directories, backup exclusion,")
    plan.comment("candidate network block, cron/at denial, read-only scan ACLs. Claude Code login is NOT done here (operator step).")
    plan.comment("Both identities get shell /usr/bin/false: sudo and launchd run commands directly, no login shell is ever needed.")
    plan.comment("preflight: everything we are about to grant a read ACL on must already exist")
    plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-d", "/Users/Shared")
    for p in search:
        plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-d", p)
    for p in full:
        if "*" in p:
            plan.raw("/bin/ls -d %s >/dev/null" % _quote_target(p))
        else:
            plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-d", p)
    plan.comment("refuse to clobber existing identities")
    for kind, name in (("Users", EVAL_USER), ("Users", CANDIDATE_USER), ("Groups", EVAL_USER),
                       ("Groups", CANDIDATE_USER), ("Groups", CORPUS_GROUP)):
        plan.raw('if /usr/bin/dscl . -read /%s/%s >/dev/null 2>&1; then %s; fi' % (kind, name, _fail_line("%s %s already exists" % (kind[:-1].lower(), name))))
    plan.comment("ids 600-699: next free block of three (user, user, corpus group)")
    plan.raw("ZV_BASE=$({ /usr/bin/dscl . -list /Users UniqueID; /usr/bin/dscl . -list /Groups PrimaryGroupID; } | "
             "/usr/bin/awk 'BEGIN { m = 599 } $2 + 0 >= 600 && $2 + 0 < 700 && $2 + 0 > m { m = $2 + 0 } END { print m + 1 }')")
    plan.raw('[ "$ZV_BASE" -lt 697 ] || { echo "refusing: no free id block in 600-699" >&2; exit 1; }')
    plan.raw("ZV_EVAL_ID=$ZV_BASE")
    plan.raw("ZV_CAND_ID=$((ZV_BASE + 1))")
    plan.raw("ZV_CORPUS_GID=$((ZV_BASE + 2))")
    dscl = "/usr/bin/dscl"
    for grp, var in ((EVAL_USER, "$ZV_EVAL_ID"), (CANDIDATE_USER, "$ZV_CAND_ID"), (CORPUS_GROUP, "$ZV_CORPUS_GID")):
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", "/Groups/" + grp)
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", "/Groups/" + grp, "PrimaryGroupID", _Raw('"%s"' % var))
    for user, var, real in ((EVAL_USER, "$ZV_EVAL_ID", "Zurvan sealed evaluator"),
                            (CANDIDATE_USER, "$ZV_CAND_ID", "Zurvan sealed candidate runner")):
        u = "/Users/" + user
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u)
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u, "UserShell", "/usr/bin/false")
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u, "RealName", real)
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u, "UniqueID", _Raw('"%s"' % var))
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u, "PrimaryGroupID", _Raw('"%s"' % var))
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u, "NFSHomeDirectory", u)
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u, "IsHidden", "1")
        plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-create", u, "Password", "*")
    plan.cmd(dscl, ".", "-append", "/Groups/" + CORPUS_GROUP, "GroupMembership", EVAL_USER, CANDIDATE_USER)
    plan.comment("directories: owner, group and mode are set in one step by install -d")
    ev = (EVAL_USER, EVAL_USER, "0700")
    cd = (CANDIDATE_USER, CANDIDATE_USER, "0700")
    table = (
        (ZE_ROOT, ("root", "wheel", "0755")),
        (RUNTIME_DIR, ("root", "wheel", "0755")),
        (CORPUS_DIR, ("root", CORPUS_GROUP, "0750")),
        (STAGE_DIR, (EVAL_USER, CANDIDATE_USER, "0750")),
        (EVAL_HOME, ev), (KEYS_DIR, ev), (SETS_DIR, ev), (RUNS_DIR, ev), (INCIDENTS_DIR, ev),
        (CANDIDATE_HOME, cd), (SCRATCH_DIR, cd),
        (DROP_DIR, ("root", "wheel", "1733")),
    )
    for path, (o, g, m) in table:
        plan.install_dir(path, o, g, m)
    plan.cmd("/bin/chmod", "1733", DROP_DIR)
    plan.comment("T7: keys never reach a Time Machine backup (seal-check proves it with tmutil isexcluded)")
    plan.cmd("/usr/bin/tmutil", "addexclusion", "-p", KEYS_DIR)
    plan.comment("T3: the candidate identity has no outbound network (pf matches user for TCP/UDP only: defence in depth)")
    plan.install_file(PF_ANCHOR_FILE, _render_template("pf.anchor.tmpl", CANDIDATE_USER=CANDIDATE_USER).encode(),
                      "root", "wheel", "0644")
    plan.cmd("/bin/cp", "-p", PF_CONF, PF_CONF_BAK)
    plan.raw("/usr/bin/grep -qxF 'anchor \"zurvan-eval\"' %s || /usr/bin/printf '%%s\\n' 'anchor \"zurvan-eval\"' "
             "'load anchor \"zurvan-eval\" from \"%s\"' >> %s" % (PF_CONF, PF_ANCHOR_FILE, PF_CONF))
    plan.raw("/sbin/pfctl -n -f %s || { /bin/cp -p %s %s; echo 'refusing: pf.conf does not parse' >&2; exit 1; }"
             % (PF_CONF, PF_CONF_BAK, PF_CONF))
    plan.cmd("/sbin/pfctl", "-f", PF_CONF)
    plan.cmd("/sbin/pfctl", "-E")
    plan.install_file(PF_PLIST, _render_template("pf.launchd.plist.tmpl").encode(), "root", "wheel", "0644")
    plan.cmd("/usr/bin/plutil", "-lint", plan.staged_path(PF_PLIST))
    plan.cmd("/bin/launchctl", "bootstrap", "system", PF_PLIST)
    plan.comment("the candidate may not schedule anything")
    for f in CRON_DENY_FILES:
        plan.raw("/usr/bin/grep -qx %s %s 2>/dev/null || /usr/bin/printf '\\n%%s\\n' %s >> %s"
                 % (CANDIDATE_USER, f, CANDIDATE_USER, f))
    plan.comment("T8: read-only ACLs so the eval identity can scan development transcripts and traces (spec s5.6)")
    plan.comment("search = traverse only (ancestors); full = read, list, search, readattr + inheritance. Never write/delete.")
    for p in search:
        plan.cmd("/bin/chmod", "+a", _acl("search"), p)
    for p in full:
        plan.raw("/bin/chmod -R +a %s %s" % (shlex.quote(_acl("read,list,search,readattr,file_inherit,directory_inherit")),
                                              _quote_target(p)))
    plan.cmd("/usr/bin/id", EVAL_USER)
    plan.cmd("/usr/bin/id", CANDIDATE_USER)


def _read_regular(path, what):
    real = os.path.realpath(str(path))
    if not os.path.isfile(real):
        raise OperatorRefusal("%s is not a regular file: %s" % (what, path))
    return real


def _resolve_tool(explicit, name, search_path):
    if explicit:
        cand = str(explicit)
    else:
        cand = shutil.which(name, path=search_path or "/usr/bin:/bin")
        if not cand:
            raise OperatorRefusal("%s not found on the operator PATH; pass --%s" % (name, name))
    real = _read_regular(cand, name)
    if not os.access(real, os.X_OK):
        raise OperatorRefusal("%s is not executable: %s" % (name, real))
    return real


def _hf_files(hf_dir):
    root = os.path.realpath(str(hf_dir))
    name = os.path.basename(os.path.abspath(str(hf_dir)))
    if not os.path.isdir(root) or HF_MODEL_RE.fullmatch(name) is None:
        raise OperatorRefusal("--hf-dir must be a Hugging Face cache model directory (models--org--name)")
    out = {}
    for sub in ("refs", "snapshots"):
        base = os.path.join(root, sub)
        if not os.path.isdir(base):
            raise OperatorRefusal("the model directory has no %s/" % sub)
        for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(base, followlinks=False):
            for dn in list(dirnames):
                if os.path.islink(os.path.join(dirpath, dn)):
                    raise OperatorRefusal("a symlinked directory in the model cache: %s" % dn)
            for fn in filenames:
                p = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
                real = os.path.realpath(p)
                if not real.startswith(root + os.sep) or not os.path.isfile(real):
                    raise OperatorRefusal("model file escapes the model directory: %s" % p)
                out[os.path.relpath(p, root)] = real
    if not any(k.startswith("snapshots/") for k in out):
        raise OperatorRefusal("the model directory has no snapshot files")
    return name, out


def _ancestors(rel):
    parts = rel.split("/")[:-1]
    return ["/".join(parts[: i + 1]) for i in range(len(parts))]


def plan_install(plan, repo, sha, dev_user, dev_home, search_path, age, age_keygen, claude, hf_dir, real):
    validate_sha(sha)
    validate_user(dev_user)
    git_user = dev_user if os.geteuid() == 0 else None
    check_commit(repo, sha, git_user)
    if real:
        assert_clean_tree(repo, sha, git_user)
    files = export_sources(repo, sha, git_user)
    for _name, mod in WRAPPERS:
        if "scripts/eval_seal/%s.py" % mod not in files:
            raise OperatorRefusal("scripts/eval_seal/%s.py is missing at %s: nothing to install for that wrapper" % (mod, sha))
    rc, tree_out, _e = _git(repo, git_user, ["rev-parse", "%s:scripts/eval_seal" % sha])
    tree = tree_out.decode("ascii").strip()
    if rc != 0 or not re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{40}", tree):
        raise OperatorRefusal("could not resolve the scripts/eval_seal tree id")
    tools = {
        "age": _resolve_tool(age, "age", search_path),
        "age-keygen": _resolve_tool(age_keygen, "age-keygen", search_path),
        "claude": _resolve_tool(claude, "claude", search_path),
    }
    hf_name, hf_map = _hf_files(hf_dir if hf_dir else (Path(dev_home) / ".cache/huggingface/hub" / DEFAULT_HF_MODEL))

    plan.comment("install: broker sources from reviewed commit %s (scripts/eval_seal tree %s)" % (sha, tree))
    plan.comment("Everything the sealed side executes ends up root:wheel, 0555/0444. Installed in place; any failure leaves the")
    plan.comment("sudoers digest stale, so sudo refuses the broker (fail closed). sudoers is installed last.")
    plan.comment("pinned binaries are copied, then hashed; the hash is of the bytes that get installed:")
    plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-d", ZE_ROOT)
    plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-d", KEYS_DIR)
    plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-x", CLT_PYTHON)
    plan.raw('[ "$(/usr/bin/stat -f %%Su %s)" = root ] || { echo "refusing: the CLT python is not root-owned" >&2; exit 1; }'
             % shlex.quote(CLT_PYTHON))
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-rf", BROKER_DIR, RUNTIME_DIR + "/hf")

    plan.install_dir(BROKER_DIR, "root", "wheel", "0555")
    plan.install_dir(BROKER_BIN, "root", "wheel", "0555")
    plan.install_dir(BROKER_DIR + "/lib", "root", "wheel", "0555")
    dirs = set()
    for rel in files:
        for a in _ancestors(rel):
            dirs.add(a)
    for d in sorted(dirs):
        plan.install_dir(BROKER_DIR + "/lib/" + d, "root", "wheel", "0555")
    for rel in sorted(files):
        plan.install_file(BROKER_DIR + "/lib/" + rel, files[rel], "root", "wheel", "0444")

    wrappers = {}
    for name, mod in WRAPPERS:
        data = wrapper_text(mod).encode()
        wrappers[BROKER_BIN + "/" + name] = data
        plan.install_file(BROKER_BIN + "/" + name, data, "root", "wheel", "0555")

    pinned = []
    for name in ("age", "age-keygen", "claude"):
        final = BROKER_BIN + "/" + name
        digest = plan.stage_copy(final, tools[name])
        plan.comment("pinned %s from %s sha256=%s" % (name, tools[name], digest))
        plan.install_staged(final, plan.staged_path(final), "root", "wheel", "0555")
        pinned.append("%s  %s" % (digest, final))
    plan.install_file(BROKER_DIR + "/PINNED.sha256", ("\n".join(pinned) + "\n").encode(), "root", "wheel", "0444")
    plan.install_file(str(_P.installed_sha_file), (sha + "\n").encode(), "root", "wheel", "0444")
    plan.install_file(BROKER_DIR + "/INSTALLED_TREE", (tree + "\n").encode(), "root", "wheel", "0444")
    plan.install_file(BROKER_DIR + "/SCAN_TARGETS.json",
                      (json.dumps({"dev_home": dev_home, "repo": repo}, sort_keys=True) + "\n").encode(),
                      "root", "wheel", "0444")
    plan.install_file(BROKER_DIR + "/empty-mcp.json", (TEMPLATES / "empty-mcp.json").read_bytes(), "root", "wheel", "0444")

    hf_base = RUNTIME_DIR + "/hf/hub/" + hf_name
    for d in (RUNTIME_DIR + "/hf", RUNTIME_DIR + "/hf/hub", hf_base):
        plan.install_dir(d, "root", "wheel", "0555")
    hf_dirs = set()
    for rel in hf_map:
        for a in _ancestors(rel):
            hf_dirs.add(a)
    for d in sorted(hf_dirs):
        plan.install_dir(hf_base + "/" + d, "root", "wheel", "0555")
    for rel in sorted(hf_map):
        final = hf_base + "/" + rel
        plan.stage_copy(final, hf_map[rel])
        plan.install_staged(final, plan.staged_path(final), "root", "wheel", "0444")

    plan.comment("prove what landed: pinned digests, no writable or foreign-owned file anywhere under the trusted trees")
    plan.cmd("/usr/bin/shasum", "-a", "256", "-c", BROKER_DIR + "/PINNED.sha256")
    plan.raw('if [ -n "$(/usr/bin/find %s %s/hf \\( -perm -0020 -o -perm -0002 -o ! -user root -o ! -group wheel \\) -print)" ]; '
             'then echo "refusing: writable or foreign-owned file under the broker tree" >&2; exit 1; fi' % (BROKER_DIR, RUNTIME_DIR))
    for path, data in sorted(wrappers.items()):
        if path in (BROKER_WRAPPER, CANDIDATE_WRAPPER):
            plan.raw('[ "$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 %s | /usr/bin/awk \'{print $1}\')" = %s ] || '
                     '{ echo "refusing: installed wrapper digest mismatch" >&2; exit 1; }' % (path, _sha256(data)))

    plan.comment("keys: made AS the eval identity with the PINNED age binary, only when absent (a reinstall never rotates them)")
    plan.raw("if [ ! -e %s/age.key ]; then /usr/bin/sudo -u %s -H %s/age-keygen -o %s/age.key; fi"
             % (KEYS_DIR, EVAL_USER, BROKER_BIN, KEYS_DIR))
    plan.raw("if [ ! -e %s/signing_ed25519 ]; then /usr/bin/sudo -u %s -H /usr/bin/ssh-keygen -q -t ed25519 -N '' "
             "-C zurvan-eval-signing -f %s/signing_ed25519; fi" % (KEYS_DIR, EVAL_USER, KEYS_DIR))

    sudoers = render_sudoers(dev_user, wrappers)
    staged = plan.stage_bytes(SUDOERS_FILE, sudoers.encode())
    plan.cmd("/usr/sbin/visudo", "-c", "-f", staged)
    plan.cmd("/usr/bin/install", "-o", "root", "-g", "wheel", "-m", "0440", staged, SUDOERS_FILE)
    plan.raw("/usr/sbin/visudo -c -f %s || { /bin/rm -f %s; echo 'refusing: installed sudoers does not parse' >&2; exit 1; }"
             % (SUDOERS_FILE, SUDOERS_FILE))
    plan.raw("/usr/sbin/visudo -c || { /bin/rm -f %s; echo 'refusing: sudoers configuration does not parse' >&2; exit 1; }" % SUDOERS_FILE)

    plist = _render_template("scan.launchd.plist.tmpl", EVAL_USER=EVAL_USER, BROKER_PATH=BROKER_WRAPPER)
    staged_plist = plan.stage_bytes(SCAN_PLIST, plist.encode())
    plan.cmd("/usr/bin/plutil", "-lint", staged_plist)
    plan.install_staged(SCAN_PLIST, staged_plist, "root", "wheel", "0644")
    plan.raw("/bin/launchctl bootout system/%s 2>/dev/null || true" % SCAN_LABEL)
    plan.cmd("/bin/launchctl", "bootstrap", "system", SCAN_PLIST)
    plan.cmd("/bin/echo", "installed broker from %s" % sha)


def _walk_export(export_dir):
    root = os.path.abspath(str(export_dir))
    if not os.path.isdir(root) or os.path.islink(root):
        raise OperatorRefusal("the export directory does not exist or is a symlink: %s" % export_dir)
    dirs, files = [], []
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root, topdown=True, followlinks=False):
        for dn in sorted(dirnames):
            full = os.path.join(dirpath, dn)
            if os.path.islink(full):
                raise OperatorRefusal("symlink in the corpus export: %s" % full)
            rel = os.path.relpath(full, root)
            _check_name(rel)
            dirs.append(rel)
        for fn in sorted(filenames):
            full = os.path.join(dirpath, fn)
            st = os.lstat(full)
            import stat as _stat
            if _stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
                raise OperatorRefusal("symlink in the corpus export: %s" % full)
            if not _stat.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
                raise OperatorRefusal("special file in the corpus export: %s" % full)
            if st.st_nlink != 1:
                raise OperatorRefusal("hardlink in the corpus export (links=%d): %s" % (st.st_nlink, full))
            rel = os.path.relpath(full, root)
            _check_name(rel)
            files.append(rel)
    if not files:
        raise OperatorRefusal("the export directory is empty")
    return root, sorted(dirs), sorted(files)


def _check_name(rel):
    if any(ord(c) < 0x20 or ord(c) == 0x7F for c in rel):
        raise OperatorRefusal("control character in a corpus file name")


def plan_install_corpus(plan, export_dir):
    root, dirs, files = _walk_export(export_dir)
    plan.comment("install_corpus: copy (install(1) writes new inodes, never links) the export into the pinned corpus directory")
    plan.comment("the digest printed at the end is computed from the INSTALLED bytes with the installed code")
    plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-f", BROKER_DIR + "/lib/scripts/eval_seal/corpus.py")
    plan.raw("/usr/bin/dscl . -read /Groups/%s >/dev/null" % CORPUS_GROUP)
    plan.raw('if [ -n "$(/bin/ls -A %s)" ]; then echo "refusing: corpus directory is not empty (remove it deliberately first)" >&2; exit 1; fi'
             % CORPUS_DIR)
    for d in dirs:
        plan.install_dir(CORPUS_DIR + "/" + d, "root", CORPUS_GROUP, "0750")
    for f in files:
        plan.cmd("/usr/bin/install", "-o", "root", "-g", CORPUS_GROUP, "-m", "0440", os.path.join(root, f), CORPUS_DIR + "/" + f)
    plan.raw('if [ -n "$(/usr/bin/find %s \\( -type f -links +1 -o -type l \\) -print)" ]; '
             'then echo "refusing: hardlink or symlink in the installed corpus" >&2; exit 1; fi' % CORPUS_DIR)
    code = ('import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "%s"); from pathlib import Path; '
            'from scripts.eval_seal.corpus import corpus_sha256; '
            'print("corpus_sha256 " + corpus_sha256(Path("%s")))') % (BROKER_LIB, CORPUS_DIR)
    plan.cmd(CLT_PYTHON, "-I", "-c", code)


def plan_tamper_drill(plan, dev_user):
    validate_user(dev_user)
    b = BROKER_WRAPPER
    bak = b + ".bak"
    plan.comment("tamper drill (gate 1b oracle): a wrapper changed by ONE byte must make sudo refuse it; restored afterwards.")
    plan.comment("Run only after install.sh. Any failure leaves the wrapper restored by the EXIT trap.")
    plan.cmd("/bin/test", "-f", b)
    plan.cmd("/bin/cp", "-p", b, bak)
    plan.raw("trap 'if [ -e %s ]; then /bin/mv -f %s %s; fi' EXIT" % (bak, bak, b))
    plan.raw("/usr/bin/printf '#' >> %s" % b)
    plan.raw("DRILL_OUT=$(/usr/bin/sudo -u %s /usr/bin/sudo -n -u %s %s status 2>&1) && DRILL_RC=0 || DRILL_RC=$?"
             % (dev_user, EVAL_USER, b))
    plan.cmd("/bin/mv", "-f", bak, b)
    plan.raw("DRILL_NOW=$(/usr/bin/shasum -a 256 %s | /usr/bin/awk '{print $1}')" % b)
    plan.raw("DRILL_PIN=$(/usr/bin/awk -v b=%s 'index($0, b) && /NOPASSWD: sha256:/ { sub(/.*sha256:/, \"\"); print $1 }' %s)"
             % (b, SUDOERS_FILE))
    plan.raw("POS_OUT=$(/usr/bin/sudo -u %s /usr/bin/sudo -n -u %s %s status 2>&1) && POS_RC=0 || POS_RC=$?"
             % (dev_user, EVAL_USER, b))
    plan.raw('if [ "$DRILL_RC" -ne 0 ] && [[ "$DRILL_OUT" != \\{* ]] && [ "$DRILL_NOW" = "$DRILL_PIN" ] && '
             '{ [ "$POS_RC" -eq 0 ] || [ "$POS_RC" -eq 2 ]; } && [[ "$POS_OUT" == \\{* ]]; '
             'then echo "DRILL PASS"; else echo "DRILL FAIL" >&2; exit 1; fi')


def plan_uninstall(plan, dev_home, repo, purge):
    search, full = _acl_targets(dev_home, repo)
    plan.comment("uninstall: authority first (sudoers), then network rules, ACLs, broker, runtime, corpus.")
    if purge:
        plan.comment("--purge-sealed: ALSO deletes the identities, keys, sealed sets and ledger. IRREVERSIBLE: the suite must be re-authored.")
    else:
        plan.comment("sealed state (keys, sets, runs, incidents, the identities) is KEPT. Use --purge-sealed to destroy it.")
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-f", SUDOERS_FILE)
    plan.raw("/bin/launchctl bootout system/%s 2>/dev/null || true" % SCAN_LABEL)
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-f", SCAN_PLIST)
    plan.raw("/bin/launchctl bootout system/%s 2>/dev/null || true" % PF_LABEL)
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-f", PF_PLIST)
    plan.raw("/usr/bin/sed -i '' '/zurvan-eval/d' %s" % PF_CONF)
    plan.cmd("/sbin/pfctl", "-f", PF_CONF)
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-f", PF_ANCHOR_FILE, PF_CONF_BAK)
    for f in CRON_DENY_FILES:
        plan.raw("/usr/bin/sed -i '' '/^%s$/d' %s" % (CANDIDATE_USER, f))
    for p in full:
        plan.raw("/bin/chmod -R -a %s %s || true" % (shlex.quote(_acl("read,list,search,readattr,file_inherit,directory_inherit")),
                                                       _quote_target(p)))
    for p in reversed(search):
        plan.raw("/bin/chmod -a %s %s || true" % (shlex.quote(_acl("search")), shlex.quote(p)))
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-rf", BROKER_DIR)
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-rf", RUNTIME_DIR)
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-rf", CORPUS_DIR)
    plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-rf", STAGE_DIR)
    plan.cmd("/bin/rmdir", ZE_ROOT)
    plan.raw("/bin/rmdir %s || true" % DROP_DIR)
    if purge:
        plan.cmd("/usr/bin/tmutil", "removeexclusion", "-p", KEYS_DIR)
        plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-rf", EVAL_HOME)
        plan.cmd("/bin/rm", "-rf", CANDIDATE_HOME)
        for user in (EVAL_USER, CANDIDATE_USER):
            plan.cmd("/usr/bin/dscl", ".", "-delete", "/Users/" + user)
        for grp in (EVAL_USER, CANDIDATE_USER, CORPUS_GROUP):
            plan.cmd("/usr/bin/dscl", ".", "-delete", "/Groups/" + grp)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ cli

def build_parser():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="render.py", description="Render the operator plan for one script.")
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="kind", required=True)

    def common(p):
        p.add_argument("--stage", required=True)
        p.add_argument("--repo", default=None)
        p.add_argument("--dev-user", default=None)
        p.add_argument("--dev-home", default=None)
        p.add_argument("--real", action="store_true")
        p.add_argument("--search-path", default=None)

    for k in ("setup", "tamper-drill"):
        common(sub.add_parser(k))
    p = sub.add_parser("uninstall")
    common(p)
    p.add_argument("--purge-sealed", action="store_true")
    p = sub.add_parser("install")
    common(p)
    p.add_argument("--sha", required=True)
    for opt in ("age", "age-keygen", "claude", "hf-dir"):
        p.add_argument("--" + opt, default=None)
    p = sub.add_parser("install-corpus")
    common(p)
    p.add_argument("--export-dir", required=True)
    return ap


def render_main(argv=None):
    args = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    try:
        stage = check_stage(args.stage)
        dev_user = validate_user(args.dev_user) if args.dev_user else "devuser"
        dev_home = os.path.abspath(args.dev_home) if args.dev_home else "/Users/" + dev_user
        repo = os.path.abspath(args.repo) if args.repo else os.getcwd()
        plan = Plan(args.kind, stage)
        if args.kind == "setup":
            plan_setup(plan, dev_home, repo)
        elif args.kind == "install":
            plan_install(plan, repo, args.sha, dev_user, dev_home, args.search_path, args.age, args.age_keygen,
                         args.claude, args.hf_dir, args.real)
        elif args.kind == "install-corpus":
            plan_install_corpus(plan, args.export_dir)
        elif args.kind == "tamper-drill":
            plan_tamper_drill(plan, dev_user)
        elif args.kind == "uninstall":
            plan_uninstall(plan, dev_home, repo, args.purge_sealed)
        plan.write()
    except OperatorRefusal as exc:
        sys.stderr.write("refusing: %s\n" % exc)
        return 2
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(render_main())

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# Shared by every operator script: source it, never run it.
# Real mode: root only (via sudo), stages into a root-owned directory, then runs the SAME commands.txt that
# --render writes. --render DIR performs no privileged action at all.
set -euo pipefail
SEAL_ORIG_PATH=${PATH:-}
PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin
export PATH
SEAL_PY=/Library/Developer/CommandLineTools/Library/Frameworks/Python3.framework/Versions/3.9/bin/python3
SEAL_PYCACHE=/private/var/root/.zurvan-seal-pycache
SEAL_HERE=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
SEAL_REPO_DEFAULT=$(cd "$SEAL_HERE/../.." && pwd)
SEAL_RENDER=""
SEAL_REST=()

seal_die() {
    printf 'refusing: %s\n' "$1" >&2
    exit 2
}

# Split --render DIR out of the arguments; everything else lands in SEAL_REST.
seal_parse() {
    SEAL_RENDER=""
    SEAL_REST=()
    while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
        case "$1" in
            --render)
                [ $# -ge 2 ] || seal_die "--render needs a directory"
                SEAL_RENDER=$2
                shift 2
                ;;
            --render=*)
                SEAL_RENDER=${1#--render=}
                shift
                ;;
            *)
                SEAL_REST+=("$1")
                shift
                ;;
        esac
    done
    if [ "${SEAL_RENDER:-x}" = "" ]; then
        seal_die "--render needs a non-empty directory"
    fi
}

# Real mode only: root, through sudo, from a named development account.
seal_gate() {
    if [ -n "$SEAL_RENDER" ]; then
        return 0
    fi
    if [ "$(/usr/bin/id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
        seal_die "real mode must run as root (sudo); use --render DIR to preview without changing anything"
    fi
    [ -n "${SUDO_USER:-}" ] || seal_die "SUDO_USER is not set: run this through sudo from the development account"
    [ "$SUDO_USER" != root ] || seal_die "SUDO_USER must be the development account, not root"
}

# seal_exec <kind> [render.py args...]
seal_exec() {
    local kind=$1
    shift
    [ -x "$SEAL_PY" ] || seal_die "the Command Line Tools python 3.9 is missing: $SEAL_PY"
    if [ -n "$SEAL_RENDER" ]; then
        "$SEAL_PY" -I -X "pycache_prefix=$SEAL_PYCACHE" "$SEAL_HERE/render.py" "$kind" \
            --repo "$SEAL_REPO_DEFAULT" --dev-user "${SUDO_USER:-devuser}" --search-path "$SEAL_ORIG_PATH" \
            "$@" --stage "$SEAL_RENDER"
        printf 'rendered the %s plan into %s (nothing was changed)\n' "$kind" "$SEAL_RENDER"
        return 0
    fi
    local dev_home stage
    dev_home=$(/usr/bin/dscl . -read "/Users/$SUDO_USER" NFSHomeDirectory | /usr/bin/awk '{print $2}')
    [ -n "$dev_home" ] || seal_die "could not resolve the home directory of $SUDO_USER"
    stage=$(/usr/bin/mktemp -d /private/var/root/zurvan-seal.XXXXXX)
    # shellcheck disable=SC2064
    trap "/bin/rm -rf '$stage'" EXIT
    "$SEAL_PY" -I -X "pycache_prefix=$SEAL_PYCACHE" "$SEAL_HERE/render.py" "$kind" \
        --repo "$SEAL_REPO_DEFAULT" --search-path "$SEAL_ORIG_PATH" \
        "$@" --stage "$stage" --real --dev-user "$SUDO_USER" --dev-home "$dev_home"
    /bin/bash -euo pipefail "$stage/commands.txt"
}

# /etc/sudoers.d/zurvan-eval -- generated by scripts/eval_seal/install.sh. Do not edit by hand.
# Exactly two rules, each pinned by sha256 digest of a root-owned wrapper (spec s5.1).
# Any change to a wrapper makes sudo refuse to run it. env_keep and env_check are emptied
# for both run-as identities, so nothing from the caller's environment survives.
Defaults>${EVAL_USER} env_reset, !setenv, !env_keep, !env_check
Defaults>${CANDIDATE_USER} env_reset, !setenv, !env_keep, !env_check

No other collision across 111 definitions.

**Sudoers syntax verified without root** (`/usr/sbin/visudo -c -f <file>` is a pure parser run, exit code 0/1):
- `Defaults>zurvaneval env_reset, !setenv, !env_keep, !env_check` parses (`parsed OK`). `!env_keep` is the way to empty the list; `Defaults>zurvaneval env_keep=""` is a SYNTAX ERROR (`empty string`), so do not use it.
- `Defaults>runasuser` scopes by the identity being run as, so both rules are covered no matter who invokes sudo. `dev ALL=(zurvaneval) NOPASSWD: sha256:<hex> /abs/path` parses; a user name containing a dot is fine.
- A garbage line is rejected (exit 1). `validate_sudoers` (render.py) is the structural allowlist on top of that: exactly two rule lines of an exact shape, exactly two exact Defaults lines, no include directives, no backslash, digests recomputed from the wrapper bytes. `render_sudoers` runs it on its own output and refuses to emit a file that fails it. visudo accepts `raoof ALL=(ALL) ALL` as valid syntax, which is why the validator exists.

**Premises NOT verified without root (the operator must see each pass on the real machine; the Z1b live-proof set covers them):**
1. User and group creation: the `dscl` sequence (ids 600-699 allocation, `IsHidden`, `Password '*'`, `UserShell /usr/bin/false`, `GroupMembership`), and that macOS accepts ids below 700 for non-system accounts without side effects (TCC, Sharing, Setup Assistant).
2. `tmutil addexclusion -p /Users/zurvaneval/keys` on a real directory, and `tmutil isexcluded` then reporting `[Excluded]`.
3. pf: that `block drop out quick user zurvancandidate` is effective (pf matches `user` for TCP and UDP only, so ICMP is not covered), that appending the anchor and `load anchor` lines to `/etc/pf.conf` parses (`pfctl -n -f` is in the plan and aborts with a restore if not), that `pfctl -E` plus the LaunchDaemon survive reboot, and that an OS update may overwrite `/etc/pf.conf` (uninstall removes our lines by pattern).
4. ACL traversal and TCC: that `chmod +a ... search` on `~`, `~/Desktop` and the repo is enough for the eval identity to read `~/Desktop/Raouf/Zurvan/...`. macOS TCC protects `~/Desktop`, `~/Documents` and `~/Downloads` per application; the scan runs as a launchd daemon running the CLT python, which may need Full Disk Access. The scan is built to fail closed (`SCAN_INCOMPLETE`), so a TCC block shows up as a refusal, not a silent pass.
5. sudo digest refusal: the exact refusal text sudo prints on a digest mismatch (so the drill asserts only: non-zero exit and output that is not a JSON document), that sudo on macOS (no `fexecve`) is safe because the wrapper directory is root-owned 0555, and that `Defaults>runas !env_keep` really empties the list (verified only that it parses; `sudo -V` as root lists the effective env_keep).
6. `claude login` as `zurvaneval` (a user whose shell is `/usr/bin/false`, run as `sudo -u zurvaneval -H /Library/ZurvanEval/broker/bin/claude login`): whether the OAuth flow works from that identity, and that the pinned copy of `claude` runs from a root-owned directory (no self-update writes).
7. `/usr/lib/cron/cron.deny` and `at.deny` are writable by root through the `/usr/lib/cron -> /var/at` symlink (they exist on this machine; SIP status of that path is unverified).
8. `install -d -m 1733` honouring the sticky bit (a separate `chmod 1733` follows).
9. Hugging Face offline load from a root-owned, read-only `HF_HOME` (the cache may want to create `.locks`).
10. The real `age`, `age-keygen` and `claude` binaries resolve through the operator's own PATH under sudo (macOS sudo normally keeps PATH; otherwise pass `--age`, `--age-keygen`, `--claude`).

**Contract deviations and gaps for the orchestrator:**
- HIGH, gap: nothing in Tasks 1-13 installs a Python runtime for the CANDIDATE. Contract s3.8 runs `scripts/z1b_candidate.py` under a "candidate runtime python" that needs `sentence_transformers`, `sqlite_vec`, `torch` (today only in `/opt/anaconda3`, user-writable). The brief only asks for the HF model copy, and a venv build needs network access and a pinned wheel set, so `install.sh` does not invent one. Until it exists the sealed candidate run cannot execute. Needs a ruling (offline wheelhouse copied root-owned, or a pinned framework python).
- MED, contract gap: `broker scan` takes no arguments but `scan_targets(paths, dev_home, repo)` needs the dev home and repo. `install.sh` writes `/Library/ZurvanEval/broker/SCAN_TARGETS.json` (`{"dev_home", "repo"}`, root:wheel 0444); Task 10 must read it. `author.py` needs the empty MCP config at `/Library/ZurvanEval/broker/empty-mcp.json`. `INSTALLED_TREE` (the broker reports `installed_tree`) sits at `broker/INSTALLED_TREE`; `SealPaths` has no property for it or for these two files. Suggest adding `installed_tree_file`, `scan_targets_file`, `empty_mcp_file`.
- MED, operational: the ACL grant on `~/.claude/projects/*Zurvan*` covers the directories that exist when setup runs; a later worktree's transcript directory is not readable until the ACL is added (the scan would then refuse with `SCAN_INCOMPLETE`). There is no `--refresh-acls` script; add one if worktrees keep appearing.
- MED, assumption: wrappers call `main(sys.argv[1:])` in `broker`, `candidate_run` and `author` (the brief showed `main()`; the contract gives `broker.main(argv=None, ...)` and `candidate_run.main(argv)`, and `author.main` is not in contract s3.12). Task 13 must define `author.main(argv) -> int`.
- LOW, extras added: `_lib.sh`, `templates/pf.launchd.plist.tmpl` (pf is otherwise not re-enabled after reboot), `SCAN_TARGETS.json`. `sandbox/candidate.sb` is exported inside the broker lib (`lib/scripts/eval_seal/sandbox/candidate.sb`), not installed separately; `candidate_run` must locate it relative to its own file.
- LOW, design choices: (1) key generation lives in `install.sh`, after the pinned `age-keygen` is installed and hash-verified, and only when the key file is absent, so a reinstall never rotates keys; setup stays free of any dev-side binary. (2) Both identities get shell `/usr/bin/false`: `sudo -u` runs the command directly and launchd needs no shell. (3) Dedicated primary groups `zurvaneval` and `zurvancandidate` exist because the stage directory is `zurvaneval:zurvancandidate`. (4) Uninstall keeps the identities, keys, sets and ledger unless `--purge-sealed` (losing them forces re-authoring). (5) `runs/` is not Time Machine excluded, only `keys/` as the spec says; if per-item rows should not be backed up either, exclude `runs/` too.
- LOW, hardening beyond the brief: when root, git runs as the dev user (`sudo -u <dev>`) so a hostile repo config cannot execute as root; render.py runs under `-I -X pycache_prefix=/private/var/root/...` so a stale or forged `.pyc` in the dev-writable tree is never read; in real mode `install.sh` refuses if the working-tree `scripts/eval_seal` differs from the reviewed sha (root runs `render.py` and `_lib.sh` live from that tree); every exported file's bytes are re-hashed against the git blob id (defeats `export-subst` and `.gitattributes` rewriting).
- LOW, residual: commit and tree objects themselves are not re-verified against their ids (only blobs are), so a dev who can plant a forged loose object could still pass a tampered tree; mitigated by Raouf reviewing the sha and by root-owned results, not eliminated. `--render` into a directory that already holds a `commands.txt` symlink would follow it (render mode does not run as root).
- LOW: the corpus is copied straight from the export directory (no second staged copy, since `search.sqlite` is large); the digest printed at the end is computed from the installed bytes, which is what binds. A swap in the export directory between render and copy is possible but is caught by the operator comparing the printed `corpus_sha256` with the manifest.

# ------------------------------------------------------------------ make_bundle

def _t13_heads(bundle):
    out = subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git", "bundle", "list-heads", str(bundle)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                         check=True, env={"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null"}).stdout
    return dict((ref, sha) for sha, ref in (line.split(" ", 1) for line in out.splitlines()))


def test_t13_make_bundle_head_is_exactly_the_requested_commit_even_when_interior(t13):
    for commit in (t13.c2, t13.c1):  # c1 is NOT the repo HEAD
        name = zc.make_bundle(commit, repo=t13.repo, drop_dir=t13.drop)
        assert re.fullmatch(intake.BUNDLE_NAME_RE, name) and name.startswith("z1b-" + commit + "-")
        assert _t13_heads(t13.drop / name)["HEAD"] == commit
        assert stat.S_IMODE((t13.drop / name).stat().st_mode) == 0o644
    assert len(list(t13.drop.iterdir())) == 2


def test_t13_make_bundle_never_mutates_the_callers_repository(t13):
    before = _t13_git(t13.repo, "for-each-ref")
    head = _t13_git(t13.repo, "symbolic-ref", "HEAD")
    zc.make_bundle(t13.c1, repo=t13.repo, drop_dir=t13.drop)
    assert _t13_git(t13.repo, "for-each-ref") == before
    assert _t13_git(t13.repo, "symbolic-ref", "HEAD") == head
    assert "z1b" not in _t13_git(t13.repo, "branch", "-a")
    assert _t13_git(t13.repo, "status", "--porcelain") == ""

def test_t13_make_bundle_then_intake_stage_then_verify_round_trip(t13):
    """R10: the bundle HEAD must equal the frozen commit, as Task 8's verify_bundle demands."""
    paths = SealPaths.for_root(t13.tmp / "sealroot")
    paths.stage_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    paths.drop_dir.mkdir(parents=True)
    name = zc.make_bundle(t13.c1, repo=t13.repo, drop_dir=paths.drop_dir)
    staged = intake.stage_bundle(name, paths, expected_uid=os.getuid(), run_id="0123456789abcdef")
    env = sysenv.clean_env(t13.tmp)
    intake.verify_bundle(staged, t13.c1, env=env)  # passes
    with pytest.raises(Exception) as ei:
        intake.verify_bundle(staged, t13.c2, env=env)  # the other commit is not this bundle's HEAD
    assert getattr(ei.value, "code", None) == "CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN"
    assert not (paths.drop_dir / name).exists()  # intake consumed the drop file


def test_t13_bare_commit_bundle_would_fail_the_head_check_so_the_alternates_route_is_needed(t13):
    """Guard against a 'simplification' to `git bundle create <commit>`: no HEAD is recorded."""
    out = t13.tmp / "naive.bundle"
    subprocess.run(["/usr/bin/git", "-C", str(t13.repo), "bundle", "create", str(out), t13.c1],
                   capture_output=True, env={"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin", "GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL": "/dev/null"})
    heads = _t13_heads(out) if out.exists() else {}
    assert heads.get("HEAD") != t13.c1

def test_t13_call_broker_runs_exactly_sudo_n_u_zurvaneval_broker_then_argv(t13):
    seen = []

    def spy(cmd, **kw):
        seen.append((cmd, kw))
        return t13.fake.runner(cmd, **kw)
    t13.fake.set({"status": _t13_out(_t13_status_doc(t13.tree), seal_output.serialize_status)})
    zc.call_broker(["status"], runner=spy)

    assert kw["stdin"] is subprocess.DEVNULL and kw["stderr"] is subprocess.DEVNULL

    '{"ok":false,"code":"FREE TEXT LEAK /Users/zurvaneval/sets/holdout.age","broker_sha":"' + "a" * 40 + '"}',
    '{"ok":false,"code":"SEAL_COMPROMISED","broker_sha":"' + "a" * 40 + '","detail":"x"}',

    "Traceback (most recent call last):\n  File secret.py line 1",
])
def test_t13_broker_stdout_outside_the_closed_schema_is_internal_and_never_printed(t13, capfd, raw):

    assert _T13_SECRET not in shown.out + shown.err

        assert raw not in shown.out + shown.err
        assert raw not in repr(err) and raw not in str(err) and err.__cause__ is None

@pytest.fixture
def t13seal(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    if os.geteuid() == 0:
        pytest.skip("permission checks are meaningless as root")
    root = tmp_path / "root"
    paths = SealPaths.for_root(root)
    for d in (paths.keys_dir, paths.sets_dir, paths.runs_dir, paths.incidents_dir, paths.corpus_dir,
              paths.stage_dir, paths.scratch_dir, paths.broker_bin, paths.broker_lib):
        d.mkdir(parents=True)
    paths.manifest_file.write_text("{}")
    (paths.broker_bin / "zurvan-broker").write_text("#!/bin/sh\n")
    settings = tmp_path / "settings.json"
    settings.write_text(json.dumps({"permissions": {"deny": zc.client_deny_rules(paths)}}))
    monkeypatch.setattr(zc, "SETTINGS_PATH", settings)
    monkeypatch.setattr(zc, "ROOT_UID", os.getuid())
    for d in (paths.broker_dir, paths.broker_bin, paths.broker_lib):
        d.chmod(0o755)
    (paths.broker_bin / "zurvan-broker").chmod(0o555)
    for sealed in (paths.eval_home, paths.corpus_dir, paths.stage_dir, paths.candidate_home):
        sealed.chmod(0o000)
    yield types.SimpleNamespace(paths=paths, settings=settings)
    for sealed in (paths.eval_home, paths.corpus_dir, paths.stage_dir, paths.candidate_home):
        if sealed.exists():
            sealed.chmod(0o700)

                   t13seal.paths.candidate_home):
        sealed.chmod(0o700)
    import shutil
    shutil.rmtree(t13seal.paths.corpus_dir)

    # an entirely empty machine is "not configured", not a vacuous pass
    empty = zc.local_seal_check(SealPaths.for_root(tmp_path / "nothing-here"))
    assert empty["configured"] is False and empty["ok"] is False
    assert set(empty["paths"].values()) == {"ENOENT"}


def test_t13_local_check_eperm_or_other_errors_are_not_counted_as_eacces(t13seal, monkeypatch):

        return real_open(path, flags, *a, **k)
    monkeypatch.setattr(zc.os, "open", eperm)

def _t13_item(stratum="exact_identifier", page="wiki/a.md", **over):
    grading = "abstain" if stratum == "not_found" else ("set" if stratum in ("multi_hop", "synthesis") else "rank")
    item = {"id": secrets.token_hex(16), "stratum": stratum, "query": "where is " + stratum,
            "targets": [] if grading == "abstain" else
            [{"page": page, "source_id": None, "locator": {"kind": "page", "value": page}}],
            "grading": grading, "difficulty": "easy", "provenance": {"author": "a", "reviewer": "r"}}
    item.update(over)
    return item

def _t13_search(table):
    calls = []

    def search(query):
        calls.append(query)
        return table.get(query, [])
    search.calls = calls
    return search


def test_t13_dev_scores_the_dev_set_with_the_sealed_grader(t13dev):
    table = {"where is exact_identifier": [{"page": "wiki/a.md", "heading": None, "score": 0.9}],
             "where is path": [{"page": "wiki/x.md", "heading": None, "score": 0.8},
                               {"page": "wiki/b.md", "heading": None, "score": 0.7}],
             "where is not_found": [{"page": "wiki/x.md", "heading": None, "score": 0.1}]}
    doc = zc.client_dev(t13dev.dev, t13dev.corpus, search=_t13_search(table))
    assert doc["n_items"] == 3 and doc["abstain"] == {"passed": 1, "n": 1}
    assert doc["metrics"]["recall_at_1"] == 0.5 and doc["metrics"]["recall_at_3"] == 1.0
    assert doc["metrics"]["mrr"] == 0.75
    assert doc["dataset"]["state"] == "DEV" and doc["evaluator_version"] == "1.0.0"
    assert [r["rank"] for r in doc["rows"] if r["stratum"] != "not_found"] == [1, 2]
    assert set(doc["per_stratum"]) == {"exact_identifier", "path"}

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement**

File `scripts/z1b_client.py`:

```python
"""Z1b development-side client for the sealed broker (contract s4.1).

This module is the ONLY thing the development identity uses to reach the seal. It builds a
frozen-commit bundle, drops it in the world-writable drop directory, and runs the one broker
executable through `sudo -n -u zurvaneval`. Everything that comes back is validated against the
broker's closed output schema before it is believed; the raw text of a malformed answer is never
printed, and the broker's stderr is never captured at all.

Refusals are `ClientRefusal(code)`: a code and nothing else. `SEAL_NOT_CONFIGURED` is a refusal
(exit 2), never a quiet success: a machine without the seal must not look like a machine that
passed it.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import errno
import json
import os
import pwd
import re
import secrets
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

from scripts.eval_seal import output as _seal_output
from scripts.eval_seal import sysenv
from scripts.eval_seal.codes import ALL_CODES, SealRefusal
from scripts.eval_seal.paths import EVAL_USER, SealPaths

BROKER = "/Library/ZurvanEval/broker/bin/zurvan-broker"
REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DROP_DIR = SealPaths.real().drop_dir
SETTINGS_PATH = REPO / ".claude" / "settings.json"
ROOT_UID = 0  # the uid that must own the broker tree (a test may substitute its own)

GIT = "/usr/bin/git"
SUDO = "/usr/bin/sudo"
_COMMIT_RE = re.compile(r"[0-9a-f]{40}")
_DECLARE_RE = re.compile(r"eval/z1b/declarations/[a-z0-9-]{1,64}\.json")
_MAX_STDOUT = 1024 * 1024
_BROKER_TIMEOUT_S = 3900  # the broker's own run timeout is 3600 s
_GIT_TIMEOUT_S = 600
_SUITES = ("holdout", "reserve")
_DENY_TOOLS = ("Read", "Edit", "Write")
_RULE_RE = re.compile(r"(Read|Edit|Write)\((.*)\)")


class ClientRefusal(Exception):
    """A refusal on the development side. Carries a code, never text."""

    def __init__(self, code: str):
        if code not in ALL_CODES:
            code = "INTERNAL"
        super().__init__(code)
        self.code = code


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- configuration

def seal_configured() -> bool:
    """The zurvaneval identity exists AND the broker executable exists."""
    try:
        pwd.getpwnam(EVAL_USER)
    except KeyError:
        return False
    return os.path.exists(BROKER)


def _client_require_configured() -> None:
    if not seal_configured():
        raise ClientRefusal("SEAL_NOT_CONFIGURED")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- git helpers

def _client_git_env(home: Path) -> dict:
    return sysenv.clean_env(home, {"TMPDIR": str(home)})


def _client_git(args: list, *, repo: Path = None, git_dir: Path = None, home: Path):
    cmd = [GIT, "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", "-c", "core.hooksPath=/dev/null"]
    if repo is not None:
        cmd += ["-C", str(repo)]
    if git_dir is not None:
        cmd += ["--git-dir", str(git_dir)]
    cmd += list(args)
    return subprocess.run(cmd, env=_client_git_env(home), cwd="/", stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                          stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL, timeout=_GIT_TIMEOUT_S)


def _client_assert_frozen(commit: str, repo: Path, home: Path) -> None:
    """A clean working tree and a commit that exists. Anything else is CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN."""
    if type(commit) is not str or not _COMMIT_RE.fullmatch(commit):
        raise ClientRefusal("CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN")
    try:
        status = _client_git(["status", "--porcelain"], repo=repo, home=home)
        if status.returncode != 0 or status.stdout.strip():
            raise ClientRefusal("CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN")
        known = _client_git(["cat-file", "-e", commit + "^{commit}"], repo=repo, home=home)
        if known.returncode != 0:
            raise ClientRefusal("CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN")
    except ClientRefusal:
        raise
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        raise ClientRefusal("CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN") from None


def _client_objects_dir(repo: Path, home: Path) -> str:
    out = _client_git(["rev-parse", "--git-common-dir"], repo=repo, home=home)
    if out.returncode != 0:
        raise ClientRefusal("CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN")
    common = out.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip()
    if not common:
        raise ClientRefusal("CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN")
    if not os.path.isabs(common):
        common = os.path.join(str(repo), common)
    return os.path.join(common, "objects")


def make_bundle(commit: str, *, repo: Path, drop_dir: Path) -> str:
    """Write `z1b-<commit>-<rand16>.bundle` into drop_dir whose HEAD is exactly `commit`.

    The broker's intake requires the frozen commit to BE the bundle's HEAD (the runner clones the
    bundle and runs whatever HEAD checks out). A bare `git bundle create <commit>` records no HEAD,
    and pointing a ref at the commit inside the caller's repository would mutate it. So the bundle
    is cut from a throwaway bare repository that borrows the caller's objects through
    `objects/info/alternates` and whose HEAD names the commit. Nothing touches the caller's refs.
    Refusals happen before anything is written to drop_dir.
    """
    repo, drop_dir = Path(repo), Path(drop_dir)
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="z1b-bundle-")
    dst_fd = None
    dest = None
    try:
        home = Path(work)
        _client_assert_frozen(commit, repo, home)
        bare = home / "t.git"
        if _client_git(["init", "--bare", "--quiet", "--template=", str(bare)], home=home).returncode != 0:
            raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL")
        with open(bare / "objects" / "info" / "alternates", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(_client_objects_dir(repo, home) + "\n")
        for args in (["update-ref", "refs/heads/z1b", commit], ["symbolic-ref", "HEAD", "refs/heads/z1b"]):
            if _client_git(args, git_dir=bare, home=home).returncode != 0:
                raise ClientRefusal("CANDIDATE_NOT_FROZEN")
        tmp_bundle = home / "out.bundle"
        if _client_git(["bundle", "create", str(tmp_bundle), "HEAD"], git_dir=bare, home=home).returncode != 0:
            raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL")
        name = "z1b-%s-%s.bundle" % (commit, secrets.token_hex(8))
        dest = drop_dir / name
        try:
            dst_fd = os.open(str(dest), os.O_WRONLY | os.O_CREAT | os.O_EXCL | os.O_NOFOLLOW, 0o644)
            with open(tmp_bundle, "rb") as src:
                while True:
                    chunk = src.read(1024 * 1024)
                    if not chunk:
                        break
                    view = memoryview(chunk)
                    while view:
                        view = view[os.write(dst_fd, view):]
            os.fsync(dst_fd)
            os.fchmod(dst_fd, 0o644)
        except OSError:
            try:
                os.unlink(str(dest))
            except OSError:
                pass
            raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL") from None
        finally:
            if dst_fd is not None:
                os.close(dst_fd)
        return name
    except ClientRefusal:
        raise
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL") from None
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)


def broker_stale(installed_tree, repo: Path) -> bool:
    """True unless the installed broker tree id equals `git rev-parse HEAD:scripts/eval_seal`."""
    if type(installed_tree) is not str or not _COMMIT_RE.fullmatch(installed_tree):
        return True
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="z1b-stale-")
    try:
        out = _client_git(["rev-parse", "HEAD:scripts/eval_seal"], repo=Path(repo), home=Path(work))
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return True
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    if out.returncode != 0:
        return True
    return out.stdout.decode("utf-8", "replace").strip() != installed_tree


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- broker calls

def _client_validate(text: str) -> dict:
    """Strict validation by declared kind.

    validate_broker_json treats ANY `ok: false` document as a refusal, so a seal-check that
    honestly reports a failing check would be unreadable (and surface as INTERNAL). A document
    that declares the seal-check schema is therefore validated as one; everything else goes through
    the general dispatcher. Both validators are strict, so the pre-parse only chooses which.
    """
    try:
        probe = json.loads(text)
    except (ValueError, RecursionError):
        raise ValueError("invalid broker output") from None
    if type(probe) is dict and probe.get("schema") == _seal_output.SEALCHECK_SCHEMA_ID:
        return _seal_output.validate_sealcheck_json(text)
    return _seal_output.validate_broker_json(text)


def call_broker(argv: list, *, runner=subprocess.run) -> dict:
    """Run the broker as zurvaneval and return its validated document.

    stdout is validated against the closed broker schema; anything else is INTERNAL and the raw
    text is dropped. stderr goes to /dev/null and is never read. A refusal document raises
    ClientRefusal(code).
    """
    cmd = [SUDO, "-n", "-u", EVAL_USER, BROKER] + [str(a) for a in argv]
    try:
        proc = runner(cmd, stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.DEVNULL,
                      env={"PATH": "/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin"}, timeout=_BROKER_TIMEOUT_S, check=False)
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL") from None
    raw = getattr(proc, "stdout", None)
    if type(raw) is not bytes or not raw or len(raw) > _MAX_STDOUT:
        raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL")
    try:
        doc = _client_validate(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    except (ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL") from None
    if doc.get("ok") is False and "code" in doc:
        raise ClientRefusal(doc["code"])
    if getattr(proc, "returncode", None) not in ((0, 2) if doc.get("ok") is False else (0,)):
        raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL")  # an ok document with a failing exit status is not believable
    return doc


def _client_expect(doc: dict, schema_id: str) -> dict:
    if doc.get("schema") != schema_id:
        raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL")
    return doc


def client_status() -> dict:
    """Broker status plus the CLIENT's staleness verdict (the broker never judges staleness)."""
    _client_require_configured()
    doc = dict(_client_expect(call_broker(["status"]), _seal_output.STATUS_SCHEMA_ID))
    doc["stale"] = broker_stale(doc.get("installed_tree"), REPO)
    return doc


def client_run(commit: str, suite: str, declare: str = None, final_acceptance: bool = False) -> dict:
    """Freeze, drop and run one candidate commit on the sealed suite. Charges a budget run when not cached."""
    _client_require_configured()
    if suite not in _SUITES or type(final_acceptance) is not bool:
        raise ClientRefusal("BAD_ARGS")
    if declare is not None and (type(declare) is not str or not _DECLARE_RE.fullmatch(declare)):
        raise ClientRefusal("DECLARATION_INVALID")
    if suite == "holdout" and final_acceptance:
        raise ClientRefusal("BAD_ARGS")
    if suite == "reserve" and not final_acceptance:
        raise ClientRefusal("RESERVE_NOT_ELIGIBLE")
    work = tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="z1b-run-")
    try:
        _client_assert_frozen(commit, REPO, Path(work))
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(work, ignore_errors=True)
    if client_status()["stale"]:
        raise ClientRefusal("BROKER_STALE")
    name = make_bundle(commit, repo=REPO, drop_dir=DROP_DIR)
    argv = ["run", "--commit", commit, "--bundle", name, "--suite", suite]
    if declare is not None:
        argv += ["--declare", declare]
    if final_acceptance:
        argv.append("--final-acceptance")
    try:
        doc = _client_expect(call_broker(argv), _seal_output.RESULT_SCHEMA_ID)
        if doc.get("candidate_commit") != commit or doc.get("suite") != suite:
            raise ClientRefusal("INTERNAL")
        return doc
    finally:
        try:  # the broker unlinks a staged drop file; a refusal before staging leaves it behind
            os.unlink(str(DROP_DIR / name))
        except OSError:
            pass


def client_seal_check() -> dict:
    """The broker's identity checks merged with the dev-identity half. ok only when both are ok."""
    _client_require_configured()
    local = local_seal_check(SealPaths.real())
    if not local["configured"]:
        raise ClientRefusal("SEAL_NOT_CONFIGURED")
    doc = _client_expect(call_broker(["seal-check"]), _seal_output.SEALCHECK_SCHEMA_ID)
    checks = dict(doc["checks"])
    checks.update(local["checks"])
    return {"ok": bool(doc["ok"]) and all(checks.values()), "broker_sha": doc["broker_sha"], "checks": checks}


# contract names (status / run / seal_check): aliases, so the generic names stay unique as defs
status = client_status
run = client_run
seal_check = client_seal_check


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- dev-identity seal check

def _client_sealed_paths(paths: SealPaths) -> list:
    return [paths.eval_home, paths.keys_dir, paths.sets_dir, paths.runs_dir, paths.incidents_dir,
            paths.manifest_file, paths.corpus_dir, paths.stage_dir, paths.candidate_home, paths.scratch_dir]


def client_deny_rules(paths: SealPaths) -> list:
    """The permissions.deny rules .claude/settings.json must carry (Claude Code rule syntax).

    `//<abs>` is Claude Code's absolute-path form for Read/Edit/Write rules; Edit rules govern
    every file-editing tool. Bash rules are a best effort only (a script can assemble a path at
    run time): the OS permission, not these rules, is the wall.
    """
    roots = [paths.eval_home, paths.corpus_dir, paths.stage_dir, paths.candidate_home]
    rules = []
    for root in roots:
        body = "/" + str(root)  # str(root) already starts with "/", giving "//abs"
        for tool in _DENY_TOOLS:
            rules.append("%s(%s/**)" % (tool, body))
        rules.append("Read(%s)" % body)
        rules.append("Bash(*%s*)" % root)
    return rules


def _client_rule_covers(rule: str, tool: str, path: str) -> bool:
    m = _RULE_RE.fullmatch(rule) if type(rule) is str else None
    if not m or m.group(1) != tool or not m.group(2).startswith("//"):
        return False
    body = m.group(2)[1:]
    for tail in ("/**", "/*"):
        if body.endswith(tail):
            body = body[:-len(tail)]
            break
    body = body.rstrip("/")
    return bool(body) and (path == body or path.startswith(body + "/"))


def _client_deny_rules_present(sealed: list) -> bool:
    try:
        settings = json.loads(Path(SETTINGS_PATH).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        deny = settings["permissions"]["deny"]
    except (OSError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError):
        return False
    if type(deny) is not list:
        return False
    for path in sealed:
        for tool in ("Read", "Edit"):
            if not any(_client_rule_covers(r, tool, str(path)) for r in deny):
                return False
    return True


def _client_probe(path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        fd = os.open(str(path), os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NONBLOCK)
    except FileNotFoundError:
        return "ENOENT"
    except NotADirectoryError:
        return "ENOENT"
    except OSError as exc:
        return "EACCES" if exc.errno == errno.EACCES else "ERROR"
    os.close(fd)
    return "READABLE"


def _client_broker_tree(broker_dir: Path):
    """(exists, root_owned, not_writable) over the whole broker tree, symlinks refused."""
    try:
        top = os.lstat(str(broker_dir))
    except OSError:
        return False, False, False
    if not stat.S_ISDIR(top.st_mode):
        return True, False, False
    owned = writable = True
    stack = [str(broker_dir)]
    while stack:
        cur = stack.pop()
        try:
            st = os.lstat(cur)
            if stat.S_ISLNK(st.st_mode):
                return True, False, False
            if st.st_uid != ROOT_UID:
                owned = False
            if st.st_mode & 0o022:
                writable = False
            if stat.S_ISDIR(st.st_mode):
                with os.scandir(cur) as it:
                    stack.extend(e.path for e in it)
        except OSError:
            return True, False, False
    return True, owned, writable


def local_seal_check(paths: SealPaths) -> dict:
    """The development-identity half of Z1b gate 1 and 1b.

    Every sealed path must refuse this identity with EACCES. ENOENT means the seal is not there:
    it is reported as not configured and is never a pass. Also: the settings deny rules cover every
    sealed path for Read and Edit, and the broker tree is root-owned and writable by nobody else.
    """
    sealed = _client_sealed_paths(paths)
    probed = {str(p): _client_probe(p) for p in sealed}
    missing = any(v == "ENOENT" for v in probed.values())
    exists, owned, not_writable = _client_broker_tree(paths.broker_dir)
    configured = not missing and exists
    checks = {
        "dev_cannot_read_sealed": all(v == "EACCES" for v in probed.values()),
        "local_deny_rules_present": _client_deny_rules_present([str(p) for p in sealed]),
        "local_broker_root_owned": exists and owned,
        "local_broker_not_writable": exists and not_writable,
    }
    return {"configured": configured, "ok": configured and all(checks.values()),
            "paths": probed, "checks": checks}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- DEV set runner

def _client_default_search(corpus_dir: Path):
    """search(query) -> [{"page","heading","score"}] over the local corpus export's index."""
    from scripts.hybrid_search import search_hybrid
    from scripts.z1b_candidate import chunk_to_page

    db = str(Path(corpus_dir) / "search.sqlite")

    def search(query: str) -> list:
        out = []
        for chunk in search_hybrid(query, limit=10, db_path=db) or []:
            page = chunk_to_page(chunk.get("source_path"), "")
            if page is not None:
                heading = chunk.get("heading")
                out.append({"page": page, "heading": heading if isinstance(heading, str) else None,
                            "score": float(chunk.get("hybrid_score", 0.0))})
        return out

    return search


def _client_load_items(dev_path: Path, spec: dict) -> list:
    from scripts.eval_seal.spec import validate_item

    items = []
    try:
        lines = Path(dev_path).read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        raise ClientRefusal("BAD_ARGS") from None
    for line in lines:
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        try:
            item = json.loads(line)
            validate_item(item, spec)
        except (ValueError, RecursionError):
            raise ClientRefusal("BAD_ARGS") from None
        items.append(item)
    if not items:
        raise ClientRefusal("BAD_ARGS")
    return items


def client_dev(dev_path, corpus_dir, *, search=None, spec_path=None) -> dict:
    """Score the DEV set locally with the sealed-side grader against a local corpus export.

    The dev file's digest is looked up in the dataset registry first: a HOLDOUT or RESERVE file is
    refused (per-item rows never leave the seal), so this command cannot be pointed at a sealed set.
    """
    from scripts import eval_datasets as ed
    from scripts.eval_seal import corpus as seal_corpus
    from scripts.eval_seal import grade
    from scripts.eval_seal.spec import load_spec

    dev_path, corpus_dir = Path(dev_path), Path(corpus_dir)
    try:
        info = ed.dataset_for_file(dev_path)
    except OSError:
        raise ClientRefusal("BAD_ARGS") from None
    ed.require_itemised_allowed(info)
    try:
        spec = load_spec(Path(spec_path) if spec_path else REPO / "eval" / "z1b" / "spec.json")
    except SealRefusal as exc:
        raise ClientRefusal(exc.code) from None
    items = _client_load_items(dev_path, spec)
    try:
        pages = seal_corpus.corpus_pages(corpus_dir)
    except SealRefusal:
        pages = None  # an unreadable export leaves targets unresolved rather than faking presence
    fn = search if search is not None else _client_default_search(corpus_dir)
    rows, detail = [], []
    for item in items:
        row = grade.grade_item(item, fn(item["query"]), spec, corpus_pages=pages)
        rows.append(row)
        detail.append({"id": item["id"], "stratum": row["stratum"], "rank": row["rank"],
                       "set_fraction": row["set_fraction"], "abstained": row["abstained"],
                       "target_missing": row["target_missing"]})
    agg = grade.aggregate(rows, spec, per_stratum=True)
    agg["dataset"] = {"name": info.name, "state": info.state, "sha256": info.sha256}
    agg["evaluator_version"] = grade.EVALUATOR_VERSION
    agg["rows"] = detail
    return agg


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- CLI glue

def client_cli_main(args) -> int:
    """`zurvan eval z1b <action>`. Exit 0 ok, 2 refusal (prints the CODE only)."""
    from scripts.eval_datasets import DatasetNotEligible

    def emit(doc):
        print(json.dumps(doc, sort_keys=True))

    try:
        action = getattr(args, "z1b_action", None)
        if action == "status":
            doc = client_status()
            emit(doc)
            if doc["stale"]:
                print("BROKER_STALE", file=sys.stderr)
            return 0
        if action == "run":
            emit(client_run(args.commit, args.suite, args.declare, bool(args.final_acceptance)))
            return 0
        if action == "seal-check":
            doc = client_seal_check()
            emit(doc)
            return 0 if doc["ok"] else 2
        if action == "dev":
            emit(client_dev(args.dev, args.corpus))
            return 0
        if action == "promote":
            from scripts import z1b_promotion
            emit(z1b_promotion.promote(args.commit, args.declaration))
            return 0
        if action == "final-acceptance":
            from scripts import z1b_promotion
            emit(z1b_promotion.final_acceptance(args.commit))
            return 0
        print("BAD_ARGS")
        return 2
    except (ClientRefusal, DatasetNotEligible, SealRefusal) as exc:
        print(exc.code)
        return 2
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - nothing but a code leaves this function
        print("INTERNAL")
        return 2
```
